company.name: ASTRO
company.shortDescription: ASTRO Indonesia is a quick commerce start-up platform that provides groceries and essentials in 15 mins.
company.description:
Astro is Indonesia’s first and fastest-growing quick commerce platform, delivering groceries and essentials in minutes, 24/7.

With a mission to simplify lives, Astro saves people time, energy, and money through speed and convenience. Inspired by real astronauts, the company embodies boldness, innovation, and agility in everything it does.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $51,900,000, or 36.18% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $47,645,089 to $478,770,625, a 10.05x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 30 (-8 over 90 days) and market heat at 35 (-10).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
